interal_knowladge: Concentration CRn: the proportion of the top n indicators, i.e., the ratio of the sum of the top n enterprises' indicator values to the total indicator value of that category.
Enterprise concentration is measured as the province's enterprise count as a percentage of the national total for that industry.
